versions.statuteQuote: Agrees to waive remedies or rights under the Servicemembers Civil Relief Act, 50 U.S.C. § 3901 et seq., prior to the occurrence of a dispute between landlord and tenant. Execution of leases shall not be contingent upon the execution of a waiver of rights under the Servicemembers Civil Relief Act

summaryForModel: A lease cannot make the tenant waive rights under the federal Servicemembers Civil Relief Act before a dispute arises, and signing a lease cannot be conditioned on such a waiver.
paraphraseExamples: Tenant waives any right to terminate this lease under the Servicemembers Civil Relief Act.
As a condition of this lease, Resident agrees not to invoke military relief protections.
tenantExplanation: If you serve in the military, a lease can't make you give up your federal protections in advance, and a landlord can't require that waiver to rent to you.
action: You can ask your landlord to remove this clause. You keep your SCRA rights either way.
